selectionBasis: KMA public metadata tree Jeonbuk candidates, filtered against official historical station records active on target date. The selector was retrieved in 2026; historical validity and positions are individually verified, but this does not prove all stations geographically in Jeonbuk in 2024 were represented by that selector.
